description: This file defines the BluetoothChatService class, which manages Bluetooth connections and data transmission for a chat application on Android. It includes nested classes for handling incoming connections, outgoing connection attempts, and active data transfer over Bluetooth sockets.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth connection states, handles establishing and managing Bluetooth socket connections, and facilitates data transfer for chat communication.

classes.name: AcceptThread
classes.description: Handles incoming Bluetooth connection requests acting as a server.

classes.name: ConnectThread
classes.description: Attempts to establish an outgoing Bluetooth connection to a specified device.

classes.name: ConnectedThread
classes.description: Manages data transmission over an established Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, starts listening for incoming connections, cancels ongoing connection attempts or data threads.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts a thread to connect to a specified Bluetooth device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Sets up data transfer threads after a successful connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all threads and resets connection state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data over the active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: updateUserInterfaceTitle
methods.description: Updates the UI based on current connection state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current Bluetooth connection state.

methods.name: connectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts, notifies UI, and restarts listening.

methods.name: connectionLost
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, notifies UI, and restarts listening.
